label: Babcock-Parziale 2005
setting: veterans; inpatient VA blind rehabilitation center (Southwestern BRC; Tucson AZ)
diagnosis_mix: age-related macular degeneration 66%; glaucoma 10%; diabetic retinopathy 7%; retinitis pigmentosa 4%; other 13%
recruitment: veterans admitted Dec 2000-Jul 2002; VA-13 and FAST databases merged giving 190 matched cases; sampling method NR; all legally blind (20/200 or worse)
notes: Rasch psychometric study (retrospective pretest/posttest change; not diagnostic accuracy). Median age 77 (range 42-96); age mean/SD NR. pct_female = 100 - 93% male (p4). Central field loss 55%, peripheral 10%, both 14%, none 21%. Mean binocular logMAR of better eye 1.3 at entry, 1.2 at discharge (p4). VA-13 telephone by research staff 4-6 wk post-discharge (p2); FAST by clinician consensus; n_items and mode differ by instrument (VA-13 13, FAST 11 in text but 10 in Table p10). Language NR. Only VA-13 independence scale analysed (p2 footnote)
